subject: Billing handoff: invoice steward selection (portal primary, email copy)
messages:
From: Lena Hoffman <l.hoffman@archwellhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@archwellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:12:00 +0100
Subject: Invoice delivery & billing contact — portal or email?

Hi Priyom,

Quick question as we finalize the onboarding checklist: which flow does Redwood prefer for invoice delivery to Archwell? Our AP team can either accept SFTP/Coupa pushes (preferred) or receive invoice PDFs by email.

To close the AP ticket we need: the remit-to name and address, the legal entity that will appear in the "Bill From" line, whether you can push invoices to our Coupa tenant (we can provide an invite), and a copy of any VAT certificate or proof of business registration for cross-border VAT handling.

I attached our AP requirements doc so you can see field-level expectations. If you prefer email copies instead of portal pushes, please confirm who should be the billing contact (name + ap@redwood.com style) and whether we're cleared for PDF-only delivery or need additional metadata (PO number in subject, invoice XML, etc.).

Goal: finalize delivery method by EOD Friday so we can process payment terms (Net30) in our system.

Thanks,
Lena Hoffman
AP Manager — Archwell Health
attachments: archwell-ap-invoice-requirements.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffman <l.hoffman@archwellhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 09:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & billing contact — portal or email?

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear checklist and the attachment.

Short answer: we're happy to make Coupa the primary ingestion path with email copies for the first 90 days while our AP teams reconcile entries. That gives Archwell the structured data you want and gives both sides a short fallback window. Proposed specifics:

- Invoice "Bill From": Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Address: 4126 Mariner Way, Suite 200, San Mateo, CA 94404, USA
- Billing contact (for PDF copies / human questions): ap@redwood.com (c/o Grace O'Connor, Head of Finance Ops)
- Portal: yes — we can push invoices to your Coupa tenant if you send the invite link (please use the invite link in your AP note).
- VAT evidence: we'll provide a VAT certificate (or UK VAT reg. proof) before the first cross-border invoice; see the attached VAT request form.
- Invoice metadata: we'll include PO number in the subject line and an abbreviated XML payload in the Coupa push. For email copies we'll also add PO and Deal ID in the PDF header to ease AP matching.

Next steps (action owners):
- Archwell: send the Coupa invite (tenant + org ID) and any XSD for XML mapping — Lena
- Redwood: provision portal connector and send a sample invoice PDF & XML for your mapping team — Priyom / Grace (attached)
- Both: agree on VAT flagging (reverse charge vs. VAT included) for EU invoices — Connor to coordinate tax flags with your AP lead

If that works, I'll trigger the connector setup and drop the sample files into a secure share. We can also DocuSign the remit-to/credit terms if Archwell needs a signed billing contact form.

Best,
Priyom Das
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: sample-invoice-Redwood-2028-07.pdf, vat-certificate-request-form.pdf
From: Lena Hoffman <l.hoffman@archwellhealth.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 14:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & billing contact — portal or email?

Thanks — that approach sounds good. A couple clarifying points before we start the connector work: 

1) Legal entity on the invoice: can you confirm the tax name to appear on the invoice? We need the exact legal entity and VAT registration number (if UK/EU).

2) VAT treatment: for services delivered from the US to an EU payer, our tax team needs a VAT certificate or statement that reverse charge applies. If Redwood cannot provide an EU VAT reg number, we'll process reverse charge and will need a statement on the invoice like "Reverse charge — Article 194" (or Archwell's AP team will code it accordingly).

3) Attachments: we received the sample invoice and VAT form — could you also include a one-line example (service line description + unit price) so our upload mapping doesn't drop the service text?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — once we have the legal name + VAT info we'll send the Coupa invite and test credentials.

Hi Lena — quick update and confirmation following Connor's tax check: 

1) Legal entity and tax info for the "Bill From" line:
   - Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Tax ID / VAT (US entity): EIN 94-3281120 (US). We do not have an EU VAT registration for the US entity; therefore the invoice will carry a reverse-charge note where applicable.

2) VAT wording we're adding to EU-facing invoices:

   - Portal push (Coupa): primary — Priyom / Grace to configure connector once Archwell sends tenant invite.
   - Email copies: ap@redwood.com (Grace O'Connor) for 90-day fallback window. After 90 days we'll move to portal-only unless exceptions are raised.

4) Attachments for your mapping team (shared via secure link / attached here):

   - vat-certificate-request-form.pdf (for your records)

- Redwood (Grace): we'll post test invoice to your tenant and email a PDF copy to ap@redwood.com.
- Both: confirm when test invoice landed; allow 48 hours for mapping adjustments.

If you prefer a signed remit/credit form, I've included a DocuSign link in the related links.

Thanks everyone — will follow up after the test push.

Best,
